integrity: The exact published generator matrix is reconstructed. Finite enumeration covers all 56631 nonzero-dimensional message subspaces, with two support calculations for every subspace and an independent normalized dependence search for the dual minimum.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the displayed ternary \([24,6,12]_3\) representative. It does not classify all codes with those parameters and does not claim higher-weight optimality among all such codes.
title: Higher-support geometry of the displayed ternary \([24,6,12]\) LCD code
